delta_observations.finding: The seven-commit Frankenstein-2.0 delta from the Trigger6 seed base to the fused head adds Trigger6 protocol/seed/handoff/materializer/workflow/database infrastructure only. No pre-existing architecture, workpackage-state, checkpoint, or runtime implementation file is modified in that comparison.
delta_observations.implication: Seed candidate priorities have not earned architecture credit merely because Trigger6 infrastructure was added. Existing F2 architecture and workpackage state remain the build-side context that every candidate must be remapped against.

delta_observations.finding: The Research-Entity delta from its Trigger6 seed base adds the Trigger6 mirror protocol/seed/materializer/workflow and supervisor 9.13AL steering; the latest Trigger5 forensic artifacts consumed by this fusion predate that seed window.
delta_observations.implication: There is no new Trigger5 architecture mutation in this seed-to-head interval to supersede the cited invocation/effect findings.

delta_observations.finding: Current Trigger4 WP105 work and Trigger5 forensics converge on the same architecture constraint: call correlation alone is insufficient. F2 needs immutable call/invocation identity plus an immutable typed semantic effect-request identity, and must keep admission, enforcement, execution receipt, world-effect verification, result re-entry, and completion evidence distinct.
delta_observations.boundary: This convergence is source/design evidence. It does not create runtime, whole-system, EntityOS/HCU, or training credit.

delta_observations.finding: Trigger4 recorded a provenance/security conflict: public Frankenstein-2.0 fixtures contain exact private canonical EntityOS source bytes despite a prior constraint against using public source mirroring as a private checkout workaround.
delta_observations.implication: Trigger6 must not solve private execution or reproducibility gaps by copying additional private canonical implementation bytes into public F2. External tools may witness behavior; they cannot become a second authority or an exfiltration path.

delta_observations.finding: Supervisor 9.13AL records private Research-Entity Trigger6 Actions run 33208832631 as failing before any job step, with no job log. The materializer and SQLite checks therefore did not execute in that workflow; this is not evidence of a semantic materializer failure and private quota/billing state remains unobserved.
delta_observations.implication: Keep the queue PENDING_RESEARCH_NOT_ARCHITECTURE_CREDIT and do not promote or discard candidates based on this transport failure.

delta_observations.finding: At the fused heads, public F2 contains research/tool_intelligence/pending_research.sqlite, while the Research-Entity mirror directory contains the seed, protocol, and materializer source but no persisted pending_research.sqlite artifact.
delta_observations.implication: The two provenance sides are currently intentionally divergent at the derived-database artifact layer. Treat the manifest/seed as the portable evidence source until private-side exact-bound materialization is observed.

candidate_reassessment.highest_value_current_external_gap: Independent runtime observability capable of witnessing subprocess/file/network/effect/resource behavior without becoming canonical truth or effect authority.

leading_seed.why_not_promoted: eBPF/kernel privilege, platform portability, privacy, overhead, and overlap with existing telemetry remain unresolved; README/seed priority is not evidence.

candidate_reassessment.counterhypothesis: A lower-privilege portable tracing/OTel-native mechanism may produce more usable F2 witness coverage than an eBPF-first tool while imposing less deployment and authority risk.
candidate_reassessment.decision: Do not integrate AgentSight yet. The next research action should compare its actual source architecture and privilege model against at least one lower-privilege portable witness candidate before any E2/E5 recommendation.
